an5.157:1.1: Pañcannaṃ bhikkhave puggalānaṃ kathā dukkathā puggalaṃ puggalaṃ upanidhāya.
an5.157:2.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave assaddhassa saddhākathā dukkathā? 3.
an5.157:2.2: Assaddho bhikkhave saddhākathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:2.4: Taṃ hi so bhikkhave saddhāsampadaṃ attani na samanupassati na ca labhati tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:3.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave dussīlassa sīlakathā dukkathā? 4.
an5.157:3.2: Dussīlo bhikkhave sīlakathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:3.4: Taṃ hi so bhikkhave sīlasampadaṃ attani na samanupassati na ca labhati tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:4.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave appassutassa bāhusaccakathā dukkathā? 5.
an5.157:4.2: Appassuto bhikkhave bāhusaccakathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:4.4: Taṃ hi so bhikkhave sutasampadaṃ attani na samanupassati na ca labhati tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:5.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave macchariyassa cāgakathā dukkathā? 6.
an5.157:5.2: Maccharī bhikkhave cāgakathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:5.4: Taṃ hi so bhikkhave cāgasampadaṃ attani na samanupassati na ca labhati tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:6.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave duppaññassa paññākathā dukkathā? 7.
an5.157:6.2: Duppañño bhikkhave paññākathāya kacchamānāya abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:6.4: Taṃ hi so bhikkhave paññāsampadaṃ attani na samanupassati na ca labhati tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:6.6: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ puggalānaṃ kathā dukkathā puggalaṃ puggalaṃ upanidhāya. 8.
an5.157:7.1: Pañcannaṃ bhikkhave puggalānaṃ kathā sukathā puggalaṃ puggalaṃ upanidhāya.
an5.157:8.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave saddhassa saddhākathā sukathā? 10.
an5.157:8.2: Saddho bhikkhave saddhākathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati na kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:8.4: Taṃ hi so bhikkhave saddhāsampadaṃ attani samanupassati labhati ca tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:9.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave sīlavato sīlakathā sukathā? 11.
an5.157:9.2: Sīlavā bhikkhave sīlakathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati na kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:9.4: Taṃ hi so bhikkhave sīlasampadaṃ attani samanupassati labhati ca tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:10.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave bahussutassa bāhusaccakathā sukathā? 12.
an5.157:10.2: Bahussuto bhikkhave bāhusaccakathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati na kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:10.4: Taṃ hi so bhikkhave sutasampadaṃ attani samanupassati labhati ca tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:11.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave cāgavato cāgakathā sukathā? 13.
an5.157:11.2: Cāgavā bhikkhave cāgakathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati na kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:11.4: Taṃ hi so bhikkhave cāgasampadaṃ attani samanupassati labhati ca tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:12.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave paññavato paññākathā sukathā? 14.
an5.157:12.2: Paññavā bhikkhave paññākathāya kacchamānāya nābhisajjati na kuppati na vyāpajjati na patitthīyati na kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an5.157:12.4: Taṃ hi so bhikkhave paññāsampadaṃ attani samanupassati labhati ca tato nidānaṃ pītipāmujjaṃ.
an5.157:12.6: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ puggalānaṃ kathā sukathā puggalaṃ puggalaṃ upanidhāyā
